races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
KATTY has shown the benefit of her debut effort in 2 starts since, the form of her third at the Curragh last time having been boosted by the winner, and she could be ready to get off the mark. Film Set is feared most as she drops back down in grade, ahead of Formous.

  1. KATTY (IRE)
  2. FILM SET (USA)
  3. FORMOUS (IRE)

races.name: Tifrums Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien probably holds the aces here with BENGAL TIGER taken to put his experience to good use having chased home a next-time-out improver over C&D 3 weeks ago. Market confidence behind stablemate Major Triumph would put a slightly different slant on things, while Rejoinder could be a different proposition this time.

  1. BENGAL TIGER (IRE)
  2. MAJOR TRIUMPH (IRE)
  3. REJOINDER (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Race Final
races.verdict:
WHOSINTERVIEWINWHO looks the pick of the weights and can open his account at the expense of the class-dropping The Scallionator. Letmeentertainyou also makes each-way appeal in this valuable contest.

  1. WHOSINTERVIEWINWHO (IRE)
  2. THE SCALLIONATOR (IRE)
  3. LETMEENTERTAINYOU (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Garnet Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
Preference is for PRINCESS CHILD, who knuckled down well when second at the Curragh last time and will appreciate the return to this longer trip. English raider Queen's Reign and the in-form Rebel Wave are also of interest.

  1. PRINCESS CHILD (FR)
  2. QUEEN'S REIGN
  3. REBEL WAVE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Bluebell Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
Course winner BESET has had a relatively light campaign and was a ready winner of a similar contest at Galway last month. She may be able to follow up. In My Teens and Caught U Sleeping may provide the chief threat.

  1. BESET
  2. IN MY TEENS (IRE)
  3. CAUGHT U SLEEPING (IRE)

races.name: Colm White Bookmaker Beggar's End Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
HELVIC DREAM was better than ever when winning a listed handicap hurdle at Listowel recently and having slipped to a career-low mark in this sphere, Noel Meade's former Group 1 winner gets the verdict to follow up back on the level. Joseph O'Brien seemingly has a strong hand with 4 runners, and his Comfort Zone may emerge as the main threat, while Factual Fact, Not Just Any Eagle and Galileo Dame are just a handful of others to consider, too.

  1. HELVIC DREAM (IRE)
  2. COMFORT ZONE (IRE)
  3. FACTUAL FACT (FR)

races.name: TRM Calphormin - Strong Foundation, Strong Future Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Recent Clonmel winner GUY'S GIRL can take advantage of a small rise and double her career tally. Espritroyale and Love Orchid were both unlucky in the same Listowel race last time and are entitled to be on the premises granted better luck.

  1. GUY'S GIRL (IRE)
  2. ESPRITROYALE (IRE)
  3. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)

races.name: SIS, Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
She may not have won this year, but NAVY WATERS has held her form really well this campaign. Having finished with more to give at Down Royal recently, Willie McCreery's mare is put forward as the answer. Vanir finished runner-up in that same race, so she rates as an obvious danger, with last-time-out winner Letiza rounding off the shortlist in an open-looking finale.

  1. NAVY WATERS (IRE)
  2. VANIR (IRE)
  3. LETIZA (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet / EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PRINCESS DAY proved useful in bumpers last season and is taken to make a successful start over hurdles in the opener. Divine Diva and Kamille Au Kanada may provide the chief threat in what should prove an informative contest.

  1. PRINCESS DAY (IRE)
  2. DIVINE DIVA (IRE)
  3. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Daily Extra Place Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for UGO BINGO, who has been cut plenty of slack by the handicapper and ran well in a similar contest at Newton Abbot last time. Little Pi and Kates Choice head the list of dangers.

  1. UGO BINGO (FR)
  2. LITTLE PI (FR)
  3. KATES CHOICE (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet / EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market will no doubt be a decent guide as to what's expected but LION ROSE SIVOLA is selected to make a successful return/hurdling debut having found just one too strong in a couple of soft ground bumpers last season. Dan Skelton has unleashed plenty of runners this week and debutant Skibidirizz is put forward as the main danger, with standard-setter Mwabani taken to fill out third on his reappearance.

  1. LION ROSE SIVOLA (FR)
  2. SKIBIDIRIZZ (IRE)
  3. MWABANI (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HARBOUR LIGHT reappears with his stable in red-hot form. so fitness is not going to be an issue and he may well outclass these. West Orchard has his limitationsa but is fit and in form, which may count for plenty.

  1. HARBOUR LIGHT
  2. WEST ORCHARD (IRE)
  3. BOUND FOR GLORY

races.name: DragonBet Cefnogi Rasio Ceffylau Cymreig Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TUNE IN A BOX is on a handy mark and can make a winning return to action. Leader Crik is unexposed but represents a yard who can certainly ready one so he can't be ignored, while Matty's Getaway and Deep Cave also command respect.

  1. TUNE IN A BOX (IRE)
  2. LEADER CRIK (FR)
  3. MATTY'S GETAWAY (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet Born In Wales Seniors' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DR T J ECKLEBURG has often run well here and returns to hurdles off a much-reduced mark after an unsuccessful 2025/26, so will take beating if retaining most of his ability. Haas Boy enjoyed a highly productive campaign last season and rates the main danger, while Welsh Charger is well treated on old form and is respected, along with veteran Faivoir, who would be even more interesting if the market spoke in his favour.

  1. DR T J ECKLEBURG (IRE)
  2. HAAS BOY (FR)
  3. WELSH CHARGER (IRE)

races.name: Wasdell Group Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OLD COAST ROAD won his sole start in points and has the pedigree to make up into a useful sort for top yard so he's taken to prove too good for Too Many Acres unless the betting suggests otherwise.

  1. OLD COAST ROAD (IRE)
  2. TOO MANY ACRES (IRE)
  3. ONETINGFORNUTTIN (IRE)

races.name: Alderbrook Handicap (Professional Jump Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A winner on the Flat in France, KLYCOT has developed into a likeable type over hurdles for his current yard and looks interesting upped to 2m for the first time on the level. He gets the vote ahead of Carthusian, who is respected having won both starts for his present stable, with Kotari another to consider.

  1. KLYCOT (FR)
  2. CARTHUSIAN (IRE)
  3. KOTARI (FR)

races.name: Virgin Bet / British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BRYNMAIR GOLD made a promising start when a strong-finishing second at Kempton and he appeals as the type who can improve markedly from his first outing. He is taken to get the better of Cornichon, who also shaped encouragingly on debut when making the frame at Newbury, while War Chest could be thereabouts once more.

  1. BRYNMAIR GOLD
  2. CORNICHON (FR)
  3. WAR CHEST

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CASHINOROYALE took a big step forward when runner-up at Kempton and his opening mark may underestimate him with further progress likely. Zarak Crown is the obvious threat having won a decent novice at Ayr, while Lots Road also has potential.

  1. CASHINOROYALE (FR)
  2. ZARAK CROWN (FR)
  3. LOTS ROAD (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
races.verdict:
SUDDEN FLIGHT wasn't disgraced when fifth at Chester over 5f last time and should benefit from the return to 6f, having been placed on 3 consecutive occasions at this trip earlier in the summer, including at this track. Several others have questions to answer but Bone Marra ran well in a similarly competitive sprint handicap last time so merits respect, while Deep Havana is lightly raced and retains some potential at this level.

  1. SUDDEN FLIGHT
  2. BONE MARRA (IRE)
  3. DEEP HAVANA

races.name: Virgin Bet EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ROYAL ACCLAMATION has been runner-up twice and is bred for middle distances, so can go one better despite looking a bit quirky when second at Haydock 15 days ago. Iron Curtain showed plenty of ability when faring best of newcomers on debut at Salisbury and should improve for this longer trip, while Donegan won impressively on debut at Kempton and is open to progress.

  1. ROYAL ACCLAMATION
  2. IRON CURTAIN (IRE)
  3. DONEGAN

races.name: Inkerman London Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty with claims here, including CRAZEE ICON, who got back on the up in no uncertain terms at Chester last time and remains feasibly treated. Brian and Naval Light head the list of dangers.

  1. CRAZEE ICON
  2. BRIAN (IRE)
  3. NAVAL LIGHT

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SPIRIT OF ATHENE boasts a good strike rate and was well on top at the finish when scoring at Leicester last month. Still feasibly treated, she makes most appeal. Sandown winner Withtearsinmyeyes and the unbeaten Prosperity rate the principal dangers.

  1. SPIRIT OF ATHENE
  2. WITHTEARSINMYEYES (IRE)
  3. PROSPERITY

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Academy Hurdle
races.verdict:
No form on show but WORLD OF THE WAY makes most appeal on paper. Why Wait is well bred for this sphere and can prove the main threat along with Gavin Cromwell's Plumton Queen.

  1. WORLD OF THE WAY (IRE)
  2. WHY WAIT (IRE)
  3. PLUMTON QUEEN

races.name: Co-Op Superstores 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
STEP BY STEP showed enough on his Ballinrobe debut 30 days ago to suggest he's capable of winning this, having been awkward early and lost ground at the last before keeping on well in the final stages. Open to improvement second time up, he's preferred to Chairmanforlife, who left his disappointing debut behind when runner-up in conditions company at Listowel last month and can be competitive back in maiden grade.

  1. STEP BY STEP (IRE)
  2. CHAIRMANFORLIFE (FR)
  3. ATOMIC CITY (IRE)

races.name: Kendellen Construction Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
LET HIM B bounced back to form when runner-up at Roscommon 13 days ago and is taken to go one better for a yard in good form. Boola Times returned to his best with O’Keeffe back in the saddle at Wexford in August and should remain competitive despite a 6 lb rise, while Gortmore Lady was collared only late at Perth last time and can be involved if repeating that effort.

  1. LET HIM B (IRE)
  2. BOOLA TIMES (IRE)
  3. GORTMORE LADY (IRE)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MARTYMILL has long since looked a stayer in the making and should be suited by the return to more galloping track second time up over hurdles. Conor'salwaysright also managed to win in bumpers and looks the main danger on hurdling debut, while Square Jasmin sets the standard on his sole previous hurdling start and should also be involved.

  1. MARTYMILL (IRE)
  2. CONOR'SALWAYSRIGHT (IRE)
  3. SQUARE JASMIN (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
DAD SEZ will be suited by this return to 3m and may well get the run of things from the front so he could be worth chancing given the question marks that surround his main rival, Minella Emperor possessing the form to win a race like this but rather having lost his way when last seen in the spring.

  1. DAD SEZ (IRE)
  2. MINELLA EMPEROR (IRE)
  3. HI HO IDAHO (IRE)

races.name: Friends Of Castlemagner LGFA Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
NED IN THE PARK looks the one to beat on these terms, though Moylussa is open to improvement in this sphere, while Seven Towers should make a chaser.

  1. NED IN THE PARK (IRE)
  2. MOYLUSSA (IRE)
  3. SEVEN TOWERS (IRE)

races.name: Co-Op Superstores Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BIRDIE OR BUST wasn’t at her best back over hurdles when last seen but should be suited by the drop in trip and looks worth siding with for last year’s winning yard, currently in a rich vein of form. Cappa Hill belatedly matched the pick of his hurdles form at Listowel last time and rates the main danger if building on that, while Jasko des Dames is also respected in an open handicap.

  1. BIRDIE OR BUST (IRE)
  2. CAPPA HILL (IRE)
  3. JASKO DES DAMES (FR)

races.name: Fitzgerald's Woodlands House Hotel (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
This looks between penalised winners PASSENGER, Ifuknowuknow and Rokanako, and they are preferred in that order.

  1. PASSENGER (IRE)
  2. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
  3. ROKANAKO (IRE)
